scope: Four non-replacing White Box collaboration roads plus the existing live advisory-hour entry route.
commercial_boundary: Executable service offers use customer-owned or independently cleared assets. The owner archive is inventory evidence only and no archive payload is offered or transferred until exact quantized-copy provenance, applicable terms, notices, redaction, and a transfer review are complete.

sources.evidence_phrase: $30,000 fixed · 30 calendar days · one customer-owned GGUF model family

offers.name: White Box archive license
offers.deliverable: A separately scoped, rights-cleared archive license with an exact manifest, notices, redaction record, and transfer receipt.
offers.customer_supplies: A named permitted use and recipient boundary after Commons completes the evidence and transfer review.
offers.blocker: Exact quantized-copy source provenance, applicable terms, notices, redaction, sample review, and transfer clearance remain unresolved.

offers.name: Sponsored GGUF benchmark and diagnostic
offers.deliverable: Reproducible baseline, diagnostic report, ablation result, bounded intervention, rollback path, and AT1–AT6 evidence.
offers.customer_supplies: A customer-controlled GGUF and an evaluation harness.

offers.name: Joint-paper reproduction
offers.deliverable: A scoped reproduction plan, methods record, benchmark evidence, and publication-ready reproducibility packet.
offers.customer_supplies: A paper or experiment target and customer-owned, public-cleared, or independently licensed inputs.
offers.blocker: Price and duration require a named paper, experiment target, compute boundary, and cleared inputs.

offers.name: Private White Box evaluation pilot
offers.deliverable: A private evaluation engagement on one customer-owned GGUF model family with agreed reports, results, and rollback evidence.
offers.customer_supplies: One customer-owned GGUF model family and the agreed private evaluation inputs.
